title: Multi-Institutional Data Sharing Simulation
audience: Basic science learners exploring privacy-preserving multi-institutional collaboration.
objectives: Detect and remove outliers before collaboration.
Impute and scale local data consistently.
Run a federated-learning-style round without sharing raw records.

sections.name: Simulation Settings
sections.purpose: Choose research scenario, sample size, and outlier contamination.

sections.name: Outlier Detection
sections.purpose: Use a z-score threshold to identify values for removal.

sections.name: Federated Learning Simulation
sections.purpose: Aggregate model weights instead of sharing raw data.

chatbot_guidance: Explain federated learning as sharing model updates, not raw records.
Guide learners to apply the outlier filter before later steps unlock.
Clarify why sites must preprocess consistently.
